QUOTE: "The library itself spawns nothing." and "The mutexes are global objects in `library/threading.c` with `MUTEX_INIT`" (also: "The library reaches it through the `mbedtls_mutex_lock` function pointer")
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads, and it also says `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex abstraction that threaded callers use.
